# 🎵 Status Bar Lyric ### Synced lyrics, right in your Android status bar. An **LSPosed module** for **Android 16** that shows the line you're listening to, in time with the music, in place of the clock. No companion app, no notification access, no background service. [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric?style=for-the-badge&color=1db954)](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/releases/latest) [![License: GPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL--3.0-blue?style=for-the-badge)](#-license) [![Android 16](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-16-3ddc84?style=for-the-badge&logo=android&logoColor=white)](#-requirements) [![Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/issues) [**⬇️ Download**](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/releases/latest) · [**🛠 Setup**](#-setup) · [**🐛 Report a bug**](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/issues/new) · [**💡 Request a feature**](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/issues/new)
--- ## 🚧 Work in progress This project is **still under active development**. Things may break, some ROMs may not work yet, and some songs may sync badly. **If you see a problem or have an idea, please [open an issue](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/issues/new).** Every report helps, especially: - 🐛 **Bugs**: lyrics out of sync, the clock not coming back, crashes in SystemUI - 📱 **ROM / device compatibility**: tell me your device, ROM and Android version - 💡 **Feature requests**: new players, styling options, anything you'd like to see - 🎶 **Wrong or missing lyrics**: include the song title and artist > **Tip:** when reporting a bug, attach your LSPosed log and say which player you used (Spotify, YouTube Music, or ReVanced). It makes fixing it much faster. Pull requests are welcome too. ⭐ Star the repo if you like it, it helps other people find it. --- ## ✨ Features | | | | ------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------- | | 🎤 **Synced lyrics** | The active line replaces the clock while it's showing | | 🎼 **Line or karaoke mode** | Highlight each word as it's sung, with an optional smooth sweep | | 🎧 **Spotify, YouTube Music, YT Music ReVanced** | Reads the media session directly | | 📐 **Two-row layout** | Long lines split evenly, at the clock's own text size | | 🎞 **Animated transitions** | Lines fade out upward and back in from below | | 🎨 **Fully styleable** | Colour, shadow and outline with a live preview | | ⏱ **Sync offset** | ±1500 ms to compensate for Bluetooth latency | | ⚡ **Live changes** | No reboot and no SystemUI restart | --- ## 📋 Requirements - A **rooted** device with **LSPosed** (developed on KernelSU + zygisk_lsposed) - **Android 16** (`minSdk 30`, `targetSdk 36`) That's it. No SuperLyric and no separate renderer app. --- ## 🛠 Setup 1. **Download** the APK from [Releases](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/releases/latest) and install it (or [build it yourself](#-building)). 2. Open **LSPosed → Modules → Status Bar Lyric**, enable it, and tick **System UI** in its scope. 3. **Reboot** (or restart SystemUI). 4. **Open the app once** so the settings file is created, then play a song in Spotify or YouTube Music.
Using your own lyrics API mirror The default base URL is `https://api.lrcmux.dev`. To override it without touching code, add this to `local.properties`: ```properties lrcmuxBaseUrl=https://your-lrcmux-mirror.example.com ``` The app calls `{base}/get?artist=&title=&level=word&format=json`. </details> --- ## ⚙️ How it works Everything runs **inside the SystemUI process**. SystemUI already holds `MEDIA_CONTENT_CONTROL` and `INTERNET`, so the module can read any app's media session **without notification-listener access** and fetch lyrics directly. ``` ┌──────────────────────── SystemUI process ────────────────────────┐ ┌────────────────┐ │ MediaSessionReader ──▶ LrcMuxApiClient ──▶ LyricSyncEngine ──┐ │ │ Spotify / │─┼─▶ (getActiveSessions) GET lrcmux.dev active line │ │ │ YT Music │ │ ▼ │ └────────────────┘ │ LyricView (status bar) ✦ │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` 1. `SystemUiLyricHook` hooks `Clock.onAttachedToWindow` and injects a lyric `TextView` next to the status bar clock. 2. `LyricController` ticks every 300 ms; `MediaSessionReader` reads title, artist, duration, position and play state. 3. On a track change, lyrics are fetched from the lrcmux API on a background thread (line and word timing when available). 4. `LyricSyncEngine` binary-searches the active line for the current playback position. 5. The line is drawn in the status bar. The clock is hidden while a lyric shows and restored when playback stops. <details> <summary><b>🎨 Rendering details</b></summary> - **Line / per-word (karaoke) mode.** In word mode the sung part is drawn in the lyric colour and the rest is dimmed. `WordProgressResolver` turns the playback position into a fractional character offset that clips the highlight. Tracks with only line timing fall back to a plain line. - **Bilingual lyrics.** `TranslationFilter` drops interleaved Chinese translation lines that some sources return, so the lyric doesn't flicker between lines. - **Animated transitions.** Each new line fades out upward, swaps, and fades back in from below (160 ms). - **Two rows on overflow.** Lines that don't fit are split at the word boundary that makes the rows most even, at the clock's own text size. It only shrinks if two full-size rows wouldn't fit. If even two rows don't fit, the second row ellipsizes. - Width is capped at **62 %** of the screen so status bar icons are never pushed off. </details> <details> <summary><b>⏱ Sync details</b></summary> Playback position is extrapolated from the media session's last `PlaybackState` sample. Two things get in the way, and both are handled: - **Apps that lie about the position.** YouTube Music (including ReVanced) republishes `position=0` mid-song while moving `lastPositionUpdateTime` to _now_. Taken at face value, the lyric would jump back to an early line. `MediaSessionReader` keeps its own anchor and rejects a "back at zero" report when playback never stopped. A genuine backwards seek reports where it landed, so it's still honoured. - **Everything else that adds delay** (Bluetooth latency, late sampling). It can't be measured from outside, so there's a **Sync offset** slider (±1500 ms). Positive shows lines earlier. Bluetooth headphones usually want **+150 to +300 ms**. The active line is re-evaluated every 100 ms. The media session is only polled every 500 ms (it's a binder call), and the cached snapshot extrapolates in between. `PlaybackState.speed` is honoured, so non-1× playback doesn't drift. </details> <details> <summary><b>🖌 Colour, shadow and outline</b></summary> - **Colour**: 10 presets, a `#RRGGBB` field, or "follow the clock colour" (default, tracks light/dark status bars). - **Shadow**: on/off, colour, blur radius, and X/Y offset (dp). - **Outline**: on/off, colour and thickness (dp). Drawn as a stroked pass under the fill pass, which is handy over busy wallpapers on a transparent status bar. Settings live in a shared preference file that LSPosed makes world-readable (`xposedsharedprefs`), read inside SystemUI with `XSharedPreferences` at most once a second, so **changes apply live**. Opening the app once creates the file. </details> --- ## 🔨 Building Prerequisites: **JDK 21** and the Android SDK with **API 36**. Make sure `local.properties` has a correct `sdk.dir`. ```bash ./gradlew assembleDebug # debug APK ./gradlew assembleRelease # release APK ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest # unit tests (sync engine, word timing) ``` APK output: `app/build/outputs/apk/<variant>/StatusBarLyric16-<ver>-<variant>.apk` <details> <summary><b>Signing and publishing a release</b></summary> Without a keystore, `assembleRelease` signs with the debug key. To use your own, add this to `local.properties` (git-ignored): ```properties androidStoreFile=C:/path/to/keystore.jks androidStorePassword=... androidKeyAlias=... androidKeyPassword=... ``` > Keep signing with the **same key** across releases. Android only allows updating an installed app with an APK signed by the same key. </details> --- ## 🗂 Project layout ``` app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/afrizz19/statusbarlyric/ ├── xposed/ SystemUiLyricHook.kt LSPosed entry; injects the lyric view │ LyricController.kt tick loop: read → fetch → render │ LyricView.kt the status bar view, styled from the clock │ HookPrefs.kt reads settings inside SystemUI (XSharedPreferences) ├── api/ LrcMuxApiClient.kt HttpURLConnection + org.json (no OkHttp) │ LyricsRepository.kt │ LyricsModels.kt │ TranslationFilter.kt strips interleaved translation lines ├── media/ MediaSessionReader.kt, TrackInfo.kt ├── prefs/ LyricPrefs.kt shared settings (Style, presets, hex parsing) ├── sync/ LyricSyncEngine.kt, WordProgressResolver.kt, WordTimingSynthesizer.kt └── ui/ MainActivity.kt setup screen + style settings ``` > **Why no OkHttp / kotlinx-serialization?** The networking code is loaded into **SystemUI**, so it uses only framework classes (`HttpURLConnection`, `org.json`). That way no third-party library gets loaded into the system process. Please keep it that way in pull requests. --- ## ⚠️ Known limitations - **Position accuracy**: position is extrapolated between `PlaybackState` samples, assuming steady playback. Fine for line-level sync. - **Unsynced tracks**: if lrcmux returns nothing, or the track is instrumental, no lyric is shown (logged only). - **Word-level karaoke** needs word timings from lrcmux. Tracks without them show as a plain line. `WordTimingSynthesizer` can approximate word windows by character weight, but it is **not wired into the renderer yet**. - **ROM compatibility**: the hook looks for `Clock` in `com.android.systemui.statusbar.policy` and `.views`. Heavily customised ROMs may need another class added to `CLOCK_CLASSES`. [Open an issue](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/issues/new) with your ROM and I'll look into it. - **Legality**: make sure your lyrics API usage complies with the source's terms. --- ## 🤝 Contributing 1. Found a bug or have an idea? [Open an issue](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/issues/new). 2. Want to fix it yourself? Fork the repo, make your change, run `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest`, and open a pull request. ## 📄 License Released under the **GPL-3.0** license. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
readmeZh: # 🎵 状态栏歌词 ### 同步歌词，就在您的 Android 状态栏中。 适用于 **Android 16** 的 **LSPosed 模块**，可显示您正在收听的线路，与音乐同步，代替时钟。没有配套应用程序，没有通知访问，没有后台服务。 [![最新版本](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric?style=for-the-badge&color=1db954)](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/releases/latest) [![许可证：GPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL--3.0-blue?style=for-the-badge)](#-license) [![Android 16](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-16-3ddc84?style=for-the-badge&logo=android&logoColor=white)](#-要求) [![问题](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/issues) [**⬇️ 下载**](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/releases/latest) · [**🛠 设置**](#-setup) · [**🐛 报告错误**](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/issues/new) · [**💡 请求功能**](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/issues/new) --- ## 🚧 工作正在进行中 该项目**仍在积极开发中**。事情可能会发生故障，某些 ROM 可能还无法工作，并且某些歌曲可能无法同步。 **如果您发现问题或有想法，请[提出问题](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/issues/new)。** 每份报告都有帮助，尤其是： - 🐛 **错误**：歌词不同步、时钟不回来、系统 UI 崩溃 - 📱 **ROM/设备兼容性**：告诉我您的设备、ROM 和 Android 版本 - 💡 **功能请求**：新玩家、样式选项、任何您想看到的内容 - 🎶 **错误或缺失的歌词**：包括歌曲标题和艺术家 > **提示：** 报告错误时，请附上您的 LSPod 日志并说明您使用的播放器（Spotify、YouTube Music 或 ReVanced）。它使得修复速度更快。 也欢迎拉取请求。 ⭐ 如果您喜欢，请为存储库加注星标，这可以帮助其他人找到它。 --- ## ✨ 特点 | | | | ------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | 🎤 **同步歌词** |当时钟显示 | 时，活动行将取代时钟。 | 🎼 **线路或卡拉 OK 模式** |通过可选的平滑扫描突出显示所唱的每个单词 | | 🎧 **Spotify、YouTube Music、YT Music ReVanced** |直接读取媒体会话 | | 📐 **两行布局** |长行按照时钟自己的文本大小均匀分割 | | 🎞 **动画过渡** |线条向上淡出，从下方淡入| | 🎨 **完全可设计风格** |实时预览颜色、阴影和轮廓 | | ⏱ **同步偏移** | ±1500 ms 补偿蓝牙延迟 | | ⚡ **实时变化** |无需重新启动，也无需重新启动 SystemUI | --- ## 📋 要求 - 具有 **LSPosed** 的 **root** 设备（在 KernelSU + zygisk_lspose 上开发） - **Android 16**（`minSdk 30`、`targetSdk 36`） 就是这样。没有 SuperLyric，也没有单独的渲染器应用程序。 --- ## 🛠 设置 1. **从 [Releases](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/releases/latest) 下载** APK 并安装它（或 [自己构建](#-building)）。 2.打开**LSPosed → Modules → Status Bar Lyric**，启用它，并在其sco中勾选**System UI**pe。 3. **重新启动**（或重新启动SystemUI）。 4. **打开应用程序一次**，以便创建设置文件，然后在 Spotify 或 YouTube Music 中播放歌曲。 <详情> 使用自己的歌词API镜像 默认基本 URL 是“https://api.lrcmux.dev”。要覆盖它而不接触代码，请将其添加到“local.properties”： ````属性 lrcmuxBaseUrl=https://your-lrcmux-mirror.example.com ```` 应用程序调用 `{base}/get?artist=&title=&level=word&format=json`。 </详情> --- ## ⚙️ 它是如何运作的 一切都在**SystemUI 进程**内运行。 SystemUI 已经拥有“MEDIA_CONTENT_CONTROL”和“INTERNET”，因此该模块可以读取任何应用程序的媒体会话**无需通知侦听器访问**并直接获取歌词。 ```` ┌──────────────────────── SystemUI进程────────────────────────┐ ┌────────────────┐ │ MediaSessionReader ──▶ LrcMuxApiClient ──▶ LyricSyncEngine ──┐ │ │ Spotify / │─┼─▶ (getActiveSessions) GET lrcmux.dev 活动线路 │ │ │ YT音乐 │ │ ▼ │ └────────────────┘ │ LyricView（状态栏） ✦ │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ```` 1. `SystemUiLyricHook` 挂钩 `Clock.onAttachedToWindow` 并在状态栏时钟旁边注入歌词 `TextView`。 2. `LyricController` 每 300 毫秒计时一次； `MediaSessionReader` 读取标题、艺术家、持续时间、位置和播放状态。 3. 在更改曲目时，将从后台线程上的 lrcmux API 获取歌词（行和词计时，如果可用）。 4. `LyricSyncEngine` 在活动行中二进制搜索当前播放位置。 5. 在状态栏中绘制线条。时钟在歌词显示时隐藏，并在播放停止时恢复。 <详情> <summary><b>🎨 渲染细节</b></summary> - **行/每个单词（卡拉 OK）模式。** 在单词模式中，演唱的部分以歌词颜色绘制，其余部分变暗。 `WordProgressResolver` 将播放位置转换为小数字符偏移量，以剪辑突出显示。仅具有行计时的轨道会退回到普通行。 - **双语歌词。** `TranslationFilter` 会删除某些源返回的交错中文翻译行，因此歌词不会在行之间闪烁。 - **动画过渡。** 每条新线都会向上淡出、交换，然后从下方淡入（160 毫秒）。 - **溢出时有两行。** 不适合的行在字边界处分割，使行在时钟自己的文本大小下最均匀。仅当两个全尺寸行无法容纳时它才会缩小。如果甚至有两行不适合，则第二行会省略。 - 宽度上限为屏幕的 **62%**，因此状态栏图标永远不会被推开。 </详情> <详情> <summary><b>⏱ 同步详细信息</b></summary> 播放位置是根据媒体会话的最后一个“PlaybackState”样本推断出来的。有两件事妨碍了我们，但都得到了处理： - **对位置撒谎的应用。** YouTube Music（包括 ReVanced）重新发布歌曲中的“position=0”，同时将“lastPositionUpdateTime”移至_now_。从表面上看，歌词会跳回到早期的台词。 `MediaSessionReader` 保留自己的锚点，并在播放从未停止时拒绝“回到零”报告。真正的倒退寻求报告它落地的地方，所以它仍然很荣幸。 - **其他所有增加延迟的因素**（蓝牙延迟、延迟采样）。它无法从外部测量，因此有一个**同步偏移**滑块（±1500 ms）。正面显示线条较早。蓝牙耳机通常需要 **+150 至 +300 ms**。 每 100 毫秒重新评估一次活动线路。媒体会话仅每 500 毫秒轮询一次（这是绑定器调用），缓存的快照会在两者之间进行推断。 `PlaybackState.speed` 受到尊重，因此非 1× 播放不会漂移。 </详情> <详情> <summary><b>🖌颜色、阴影和轮廓</b></summary> - **颜色**：10 个预设，一个 `#RRGGBB` 字段，或“跟随时钟颜色”（默认，跟踪亮/暗状态栏）。 - **阴影**：开/关、颜色、模糊半径和 X/Y 偏移 (dp)。 - **轮廓**：开/关、颜色和厚度 (dp)。在填充通道下绘制为描边通道，这比透明状态栏上繁忙的壁纸更方便。 设置存在于一个共享首选项文件中，LSPosed 使所有人都可以读取该文件（“xownedsharedprefs”），每秒最多使用“XSharedPreferences”在 SystemUI 中读取一次，因此**更改会实时生效**。打开应用程序一次会创建文件。 </详情> --- ## 🔨 建筑 先决条件：**JDK 21** 和带有 **API 36** 的 Android SDK。确保“local.properties”具有正确的“sdk.dir”。 ````bash ./gradlew assembleDebug # 调试 APK ./gradlew assembleRelease # 发布 APK ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest # 单元测试（同步引擎、字计时） ```` APK 输出：`app/build/outputs/apk/<variant>/StatusBarLyric16-<ver>-<variant>.apk` <详情> <summary><b>签署并发布版本</b></summary> 如果没有密钥库，“assembleRelease”将使用调试密钥进行签名。要使用您自己的，请将其添加到“local.properties”（git-ignored）： ````属性 androidStoreFile=C:/path/to/keystore.jks android商店密码=... androidKeyAlias=... android 密钥密码=... ```` > 跨版本保持使用**相同的密钥**进行签名。 Android 仅允许使用由相同密钥签名的 APK 更新已安装的应用程序。 </详情> --- ## 🗂 项目布局 ```` 应用程序/src/main/kotlin/io/github/afrizz19/statusbarlyric/ ├── xposed/ SystemUiLyricHook.kt LSPodent入口；注入歌词视图 │ LyricController.kt 循环：读取→获取→渲染 │ LyricView.kt 状态栏视图，根据时钟设计 │ HookPrefs.kt 读取 SystemUI 内的设置（XSharedPreferences） ├── api/ LrcMuxApiClient.kt HttpURLConnection + org.json (无 OkHttp) │ LyricsRepository.kt │ LyricsModels.kt │ TranslationFilter.kt 去除交错的翻译行 ├── 媒体/ MediaSessionReader.kt, TrackInfo.kt ├── prefs/ LyricPrefs.kt 共享设置（风格、预设、十六进制解析） ├── 同步/ LyricSyncEngine.kt、WordProgressResolver.kt、WordTimingSynthesizer.kt └── ui/ MainActivity.kt 设置画面+样式设置 ```` > **为什么没有 OkHttp / kotlinx-serialization？** 网络代码加载到 **SystemUI** 中，因此它仅使用框架类（`HttpURLConnection`、`org.json`）。这样就不会将第三方库加载到系统进程中。请在拉取请求中保持这种方式。 --- ## ⚠️ 已知限制 - **位置精度**：假设稳定播放，位置是在“PlaybackState”样本之间推断的。非常适合行级同步。 - **未同步曲目**：如果 lrcmux 不返回任何内容，或者该曲目是乐器曲目，则不会显示歌词（仅记录）。 - **单词级卡拉 OK** 需要 lrcmux 的单词计时。没有它们的轨道显示为一条普通线。 `WordTimingSynthesizer` 可以通过字符权重来近似单词窗口，但它**尚未连接到渲染器**。 - **ROM兼容性**：该钩子在“com.android.systemui.statusbar.policy”和“.views”中查找“Clock”。高度定制的 ROM 可能需要在“CLOCK_CLASSES”中添加另一个类。使用您的 ROM [打开一个问题](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/issues/new)，我会调查它。 - **合法性**：确保您的歌词 API 使用符合来源条款。 --- ## 🤝 贡献 1. 发现错误或有想法？ [打开问题](https://github.com/afrizz19/io.github.afrizz19.statusbarlyric/issues/new)。 2.想要自己修复吗？分叉存储库，进行更改，运行“./gradlew testDebugUnitTest”，然后打开拉取请求。 ## 📄 许可证 根据 **GPL-3.0** 许可证发布。请参阅[许可证]（许可证）。
